head: Very Good Camera app for iPhone: three film looks for $9.99
dek: Very Good Camera is a $9.99 iPhone camera app with three film-style colour grades from Very Good Co.: VG400 for any light, VG800 for low light and VGTX for black and white. It was #26 among paid Photo & Video apps on the US App Store on 21 November.
details: It shoots JPG, HEIC or RAW at 12 or 48 megapixels, with manual ISO and shutter speed, exposure lock, tap or tracking focus and aspect ratios up to the wide XPAN format. Version 1.1 on 3 November added Camera Control support, manual white balance, a halation slider and a layout for the iPhone Duo. Each grade can be adjusted, and photos can get white, black or film-style frames. It's made by Gray Ribbon, Inc., needs iOS 18.6 and came out on 17 October.
where: iPhone and iPad, App Store, $9.99 one-time
means: If you like the look of film photos, this app gives your iPhone pictures that style as you shoot, for a one-time price.
todo: Look at the sample photos on the App Store page before you pay; the app has no free version.
